title: The Vanished Skate Key
intro: The rink's prized golden skate key, the one that unlocks the old wooden cabinet, has gone missing during the couples skate.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: My skates are brand new, so I'm not sneaky, I'm just fast.

suspects.name: Gus
suspects.line: Fixing a wobbly wheel is not a crime, grown-ups.

suspects.name: Marisol
suspects.line: I was skating laps the whole time. Ask anyone who watched.

suspects.name: Tobias
suspects.line: I only came for the nachos. Honest, nachos only.

suspects.name: Juniper
suspects.line: I was dancing to the music. Nobody dances alone like I do.

clues.text: Skate tracks show the rink floor was crossed at the spot where the key vanished, but the culprit was not last seen on the rink floor, so it was someone else.
A paid receipt timed during the couples skate proves the culprit was not last seen at the snack bar, so that visit is ruled out entirely.
A toolbox was left open near the cabinet, and the culprit was carrying a toolbox, the only one on the rink that night.
A scrap of red tracksuit fabric was snagged here. Whoever wore that red tracksuit was not the one who took the key, so they are cleared of suspicion.
